labels.S: the celebrating post, or a reply to it, names keeping as the next task, with no new damage reported first
labels.L: keeping resumes after new damage, an attack or an alarm reported later in the celebrating thread or a linked one
labels.E: keeping resumes because the close the room expected did not come
labels.C: the finish is corrected or qualified as not over, and the room returns to repair
labels.F: the celebrated work was found made (by another room, without coordination, or before the member arrived), and members keep it or pledge to
labels.R: the cited celebrating words credit or thank makers and helpers
labels.K: the cited words name keeping as members' task: a call, a duty, or a member saying they keep it
labels.N: the line itself says it shows a sequence and claims no cause
